nom: Clinique Clinique For Men Charcoal Face Wash

avis.texte: My husband is bald so this balances his head and face. No breakouts. No shine. Just a good clean. He does need a light moisturizer on his face after. It does leave him tight without it but he likes a moisturizer anyway.

avis.titre: Not a Huge a Help for Oil
avis.texte: I bought this product because I had seen where other women with oily skin conditions had bought this and had success and I love charcoal based products. I didn't have much luck with this. I wash my face in the morning and evening and by the time to wash it again rolled around it was always extremely oily. I'm even starting to have acne breakouts again.

avis.titre: Probably better for those who don't have oily skin
avis.texte: It doesn't clean my face completely. Seems to leave it only somewhat clean. Will be returning it.

avis.titre: Best face wash I can find
avis.texte: I've tried dozens of cleansers and this is the one I keep coming back to. My face feels clean without being completely stripped when I use it. It's worth the price and more.
My husband, who has oily skin, said this made his skin so dry and tight. Very disappointed.

Started using this cleanser to help with my oily skin and sebaceous hyperplasia. I feel like my pore size is reduced and the sebaceous hyperplasia is considerably less noticeable. This does not dry out my skin at all. I definitely recommend for anyone with oily skin.

Great product that I rub on my face to get rid of oils and dirt....plus clear out my pours in my face. Feels great when I apply the eye cream anti fatigue with SPF15 and the anti age facial cream. Highly recommend all of them to be honest
Really love this face wash and a little goes a long way. Doesn't feel harsh and doesn't dry up my face like some cheaper options do. A must have for my everyday routine

I really wanted to love this cleanser. It lathers so well and feels AMAZING when you're rubbing it on your skin. But that's where the good things end :( My skin is so itchy, tight, and dry now, when it's normally oily. I think I'd rather my skin produce enough oil to run a restaurant where everything is deep fried than feel this tightness.

My husband specifically asked me to order this product for him, after he tried a sample size and felt it was a good cleanser. He has never asked me to buy anything similar like that before so he really felt it provided a good through pore cleansing.

Clinique claims this item is "allergy tested." If so, they are not telling you that it failed the test. The product is full of Methylisothiazolinone (and a second related compound.) These substances were declared the 2013 Contact Allergen of the Year by the American Contact Dermatitis Society. Clinique -- shame on you for putting one of the worst known allergens in a product you claim is 'allergy tested!"

avis.titre: The War Against Whiteheads Is Won
avis.texte: Yes, I know this was meant for men, but I received it as a sample and fell in love with the product. I am light-fair skin that easily gets blotchy and breakouts. After a full day of wearing wakeup, this product cleans and my face feels refreshed. I have combination skin, so it doesn't dry my skin out or leave an abundance of oil. I obtain whiteheads easily, but with this product, it helps make them go away and stay away. All it takes is this product and a face cloth, so it's extremely easy to use and keep up with maintaining a clean face. Additionally, I liked that this is a charcoal product that doesn't leave a ​leftover charcoal residue.

avis.titre: I love this product and use it every day
avis.texte: I use this product in the am and pm to remove makeup and oil. It's wonderful. It's gentle on my face and doesn't dry it out. I'm in my 50's and have trouble finding skin care that cleans my oily skin without drying it out. I imagine it would work well for all skin types.

I have tried so many various face washes. They either didn't clean enough or left my face and hands dry. This is the first face wash I can actually feel working! You don't need much at all of it either which is awsome!! I've had it for 3 days and I can feel a difference, even hours upon hours after use. I highly recommend this!!

avis.titre: made my brother care about skincare
avis.texte: this past summer, i bought this on a whim for my 21-year-old brother, who's only skincare routine was salicylic acid on the occasional pimple. after a little bit of arm twisting, i showed him how to use it and dropped the subject. today he tells me that his bottle is almost empty, and he's been using the face wash almost every day! he says it gives a really refreshing feeling and makes his skin feel smoother. his skin type is normal, slightly oily in the summer.
I tried to get my husband to try something else and he literally asked for this by name. He doesn't even know the name of his deodorant or shampoo
Easy to use and effective product. Great for shave bumps and occasional break outs.
I bought this because it was on sale once. Ever since then I've been using it and I have seen very few breakouts.

I got this for my husband who is very picky. He got a sample in one of my orders and he absolutely loved it! He is even more picky than me. He said he feels refreshed and his skin feels soft after he uses it

I found out that this cleanser has the exact same ingredients as the women's city block purifying charcoal cleansing gel (but you get a little more in this bottle for a 50 cent difference), so my husband and I both use this cleanser. I can see a visible difference in the blackheads, especially on my nose. My pores appear much smaller and the number of blackheads are reduced. The cleanser itself is a black gel that foams into a white lather so it doesn't leave a stain on your washcloths. I highly recommend this.
I bought this for my boyfriend it works great. Its very effective, his skin has gotten smoother and clearer.
I use this to help clear my pores and a face wash before I shave, for a smooth clean shave.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: This facial wash costs more than a drugstore brand but it's worth it. It lasts twice as long because it lathers up really well. My husband uses it with his Clarisonic. He's bald headed and gets pimples every now and then. Charcoal is a good acne reducer and Clinique now replaces his Neutrogena cleanser.

avis.titre: A must have for combination skin types
avis.texte: I love this product. My face has various oily and dry zones. This product does not exacerbate either issue and works especially well for my oily zones. This leaves my skin feeling extremely clean without drying my skin out nor the "tightness" that often comes with more chemically aggressive face washes.

avis.titre: Yes my boy friend cont. to buy this
avis.texte: My. Boyfriend went from using two different Cliniques with the winter to summer to just this and loves it

avis.titre: I would buy this again, my seventeen year old son loves this
avis.texte: My son uses this daily, it is not heavy and his skin feels clean and fresh after use. He has used many products and like this the best.

I LOVE this product. I am SUPER OILY and have used Clinique for a long. I have always used the face wash for oily skin and wanted to switch it up. After using I have seen a significant decrease in the size of my pores and the amount of blackheads i have. I do use this product everyday with the men's sonic brush from Clinique as well
My boyfriend uses this everyday and his skin is noticeably smoother, clearer, and younger looking. We will be buying this again and again.
Husband loves this. Went on a trip and he missed this product and the toner.

avis.titre: I will never stop buying this!
avis.texte: I buy this for my boyfriend and it helps his skin and smells wonderful
